title: Tanker Shipping - July 28, 2026
summary: The tanker shipping market is experiencing increased geopolitical risk, with the VLCC market reverting to pricing risk as the dominant driver of freight formation. Despite diplomatic efforts, chartering sentiment remains driven by security considerations, and voyage exposure, insurance costs, and routing flexibility have become key components of fixture negotiations. Oil prices are expected to push higher due to low inventories and volatility around headlines.
